personality_one_liner: A warm, bookish editorial experience that feels like reading a well-crafted physical book, emphasizing typography and breathing room.

spacing.rule: Magazine-like spacing rhythms with generous vertical breathing room. Elements should never feel cramped.

do's: Use solid surface colors or minimal translucent overlays instead of heavy glass to maintain the editorial paper feel.
dont's: No heavy blur or frosted glass layers. It contradicts the physical book aesthetic.

screens.name: Camera
screens.purpose: Frictionless entry point to scan physical book pages.

states.loading: Camera initializing with a subtle fade.
states.error: Permission denied fallback overlay with open settings CTA.

screens.layout: Full-screen camera viewfinder. A subtle framing overlay (like brackets or a darkened vignette mask) guides the user to center the text. The bottom area contains a solid `surface` or `surfaceInverse` control bar with a large, tactile capture button (using `brandPrimary`) and a gallery icon.

screens.name: Crop
screens.purpose: Allow users to precisely isolate the quote text from the captured page.

states.loading: Skeleton loader replacing the cropped image area during OCR processing after confirmation.
states.error: Toast indicating text could not be extracted.

screens.layout: Full-screen image with standard 8-point crop handles. The top header has a 'Retake' action. A sticky primary CTA ('Extract Text') sits fixed at the bottom.

screens.name: Editor
screens.purpose: Style the extracted text into an aesthetic quote graphic.

states.loading: OCR skeleton loader if navigated here directly during processing.

screens.layout: Split layout. The top 55% is the Canvas preview area with a `surfaceSecondary` background, displaying the quote graphic centered and scaled. The bottom 45% is a ScrollView wrapped in `surface` containing the controls: multi-line text editor (500 char limit), single-line inputs for Book Title and Author, a segmented control for aspect ratio (9:16, 4:5, 1:1), and a horizontal scroll of 5 template swatches. A sticky 'Export & Share' CTA rests at the absolute bottom.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Gallery of previously saved quote graphics.

states.empty: Full screen layout with the vintage open book image, a short elegant text 'No quotes saved yet.', and a 'Scan Quote' primary CTA.
states.error: Error loading history with a retry button.

screens.layout: Editorial 2-column masonry grid. Cards have sharp corners (radius sm or 0) mimicking physical polaroids or clippings. Generous padding (`md` or `lg`) between grid items.

screens.name: Settings
screens.layout: Minimalist list layout using `Cormorant Garamond` for section headers and `DM Sans` for list items. Includes a 'Camera Permissions' row.

empty_history.alt: Opened vintage book on brown textile

permission_denied.alt: Closed camera lens on black surface

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply Personality 3 (Editorial Mobile LIGHT): Use 'Cormorant Garamond' for display titles and 'DM Sans' for body text. Keep spacing generous and UI elements sharp (radius 0 or sm). Avoid heavy shadows or default Material dropshadows.
Banned Colors Strict Ban: Do NOT use indigo, violet, purple, or any blue including navy. The theme uses warm paper tones, terracotta, and charcoal.
Implement the 5 specific quote palettes defined in the JSON for the canvas templates. These are separate from the main app UI colors and are injected into the view-shot canvas.
Ensure the Editor screen layout is split properly so the user can see the quote canvas update in real-time as they type or change templates below.
For the OCR skeleton loader, use a rhythmic pulsing block matching the lines of text in the cropped image or a generic paragraph skeleton, avoiding default spinning circles.
The sticky 'Export & Share' button in the Editor MUST sit above the home indicator, allowing the control panel behind it to scroll freely.
Empty states must use the provided Unsplash images with a gradient-to-dark scrim (top -> bottom, transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee text readability.
Add tactile haptic feedback on capture, template selection, and export actions.
